# dsh-plugin-insights

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件生态的质量数据层：全量客观健康分（A–D，health-v1），非安全审计。

Machine-readable dataset (agent-friendly): /data/insights.json
Human dashboard: / (index.html)
Methodology & rules: https://github.com/ice5kysl/dsh-plugin-insights/blob/main/docs/schema.md
Full snapshot & history: https://github.com/ice5kysl/dsh-plugin-insights (data/ directory)
